lines.en: And by “everyone else” I mean Imani, Makoto, and Nodoka- who have closed themselves off in the bedroom and are now casually drinking and discussing-
: I’m telling you guys, genomics is the way of the future!
Ahh, yes. They are discussing that.
: Hey, everyone. I’m here now, which means we can talk about interesting things.
: You really think so, Miss Imai? You’re not worried about the prospects of things like...gene editing? Because I think the stigma surrounding that is rather well-deserved.
: Ugh! Can you stop it with the “Miss Imai” stuff? I told you to call me Imani. Miss Imai is my cat.
: You have a cat?
: Yeah. Miss Imai. I literally just told you that. Are you drunk already?
: If I was drunk, I’d be in your lap.
: Ahem.
: Or yours.
: Ayyy! Look who it is! I was starting to think I’d have to chaperone this party by myself!
: Well you seem to be doing a great job judging by the alcohol in my students’ hands.
: Interesting. You’ve never cared about that before, Sensei.
: Could it be that you’re simply trying to impress our new, and quite beautiful student teacher?
: Oh gosh! Is that true?! But...no! We shouldn’t!
: You’re my senpai! It wouldn’t be right!
: I’m not trying to impress anyone. In fact, I couldn’t care less what you girls drink. I just figured Imani was going to be the responsible one out of the two of us- not just another me.
: You girls good?
: I’m fine.
: Same here.
: They say they’re good.
: How did this even happen? I thought Makoto was basically going to be at war with you for the rest of forever.
: Actually, I’m really starting to come around to Miss Imai! It turns out that she isn’t just an impostor after all! She’s actually really smart!
: Mwahaha yes, bow to the true teacher of...whatever class we are in!
: Well, as long as you don’t start taking a cut of my salary, I’m fine with whatever.

: You should honestly be happy you’re still getting paid at all, Sensei. I’m beginning to think the reason I didn’t know about Miss Imai coming in is that even my reputation is starting to diminish because of you.
: What? Why?
: Obviously because I spend all of my time doing your dirty work and, for some strange reason, have not filed a single formal complaint about it.
: Which, you know, I really should have on account of all of those times you’ve been utterly horrible to me.
: Well thanks, Makoto. I’ll make it up to you soon. Really.
: Oh! Um...oh.
: Do you not want me to?
: No, of course I do. I just thought you were being serious for a second when you’d obviously never go out of your way for-
: I’m serious. You just wait.
There’s a chance I’m only thinking this due to an infection brought on by the sensation of Christmas cheer oozing into every one of my pores, but...I really should do something nice for Makoto.
It’s one thing to constantly burden her by turning her into my “at-school Ami” in the fact that she does everything for me-
But if doing all of that is actually making her feel bad...I should at least try something.
: So, Imani, do you truly intend to stay with our class for better or for worse? Or is this a temporary thing for you before getting a class of your own?
: Depends on how much this guy likes me, I guess.
: I don’t think there are any openings for full-on teachers right now. Especially with that other school still way, way, way underground.
: I’m kinda just doing what I’m told since I can’t really afford to be fucking around currently.
: What do you mean you can’t afford it? What is the school paying you, exactly?
: Not much, dude. I don’t even have a place to stay right now.
: What do you mean you don’t have a place to stay? Where have you been sleeping?
: Where has the cat been sleeping?
: I’ve got a few months left of a spa membership thing, so I’ve kinda just been crashing over there every night.
: You can probably stay with me if you’d like. And this isn’t me just being predatorial. Though, I certainly can be if that’s what you want.
: It’s fine. Like I said, I’ve got a couple months left until it really becomes a problem.
: And I’m also pretty sure I remember the school telling me something about maybe opening up another floor in the dorm for me to stay in, so I’m just hoping that’s all set up by then.
: Which dorm? Our dorm? Or the one down the road from ours?
: Pretty sure it’s yours. Would be kinda weird if it wasn't.
: What the hell? Why don’t I get a room at that dorm? That would save me so much walking.
: Probably because you’d never leave.
: I extend the same invite I gave to Imani to you, Sensei. Though, I think Otoha would be a bit more hesitant to sleep in the same room as you on account of our relationship.
: This something I’m gonna have to report to the higher-ups?
: Is that something you actually would report to the higher ups?
: Yo. Do you consent?
: I consent to anything and everything. Let that fact be known.
: Nah, you good. I won’t say anything.
: There wouldn’t be anything to say either way since Nodoka and I don’t have any sort of relationship.
: Your class is fucking weird, man. I know you’re a hot dude and stuff, but I didn’t really expect a whole tribe of girls fighting some kinda battle royale for your affection.
: That...is actually a quite apt description of what our class has devolved into.
: Well, then I bet you’re glad you have me!
: Do you intend to dismantle our battle royale, Imani? Or do you intend to win it?
: I intend to just talk about a bunch of cool shit and then say I’m not going to participate in the battle royale, but then probably get sucked in anyway because that’s how these kinda things go.
: What a roundabout way of admitting we might sleep together one day.
: Why do you sound surprised when you basically invited me to a threesome yesterday?
: Oooooh, I’m suddenly very interested in this conversation.
: Me too.
: I heard somebody say threesome so I decided to join the conversation.
: It looks like there are five of us, though, so which two are sitting out?
: The more the merrier! Fivesome! Fivesome! Fiveso- wait. I shouldn’t be cheering that. The NSA is always listening...
: How do you even have a fivesome?! That can’t possibly work!
: If anyone would know how it would work, I imagine it would be you, dearest Makoto. What with all your wonderful mother has taught you and everything.
: Is Makoto’s mom a slut or something?
: Not...exactly?
: Well, whatever. I’m ready when you guys are. This party’s kinda beat anyway.
: You do realize you don’t have to be here...right, Kirin? If you’re not going to associate with anyone, why even come?
: What are you talking about? I’m associating right now. And I’ll be doing a lot more associating once we take our pants off.
: Damn. This bitch thirsty.
: I don’t mind Kirin being around, but seeing as we’ve got a little group of intellectuals here, I propose that we make her contribute something of substantial value to prove her worth.
: This is a really weird start to a fivesome.
: I agree with Nodoka. If you’re not going to contribute, we’re just going to assume you’re here to flirt with Sensei and-
: I’m down for a foursome without Sensei if that’s what you mean.
: Rude.
: That’s obviously not what I mean!
: What I mean is that you can’t just hijack an intellectual conversation for the sole purpose of turning it into some orgy invitation!
: What are you talking about? I am literally only here because I heard the word “threesome.”
: Okay, fine. That topic was brought up. But before Sensei arrived, this was a fun, bonding experience between three smart people! And I never get to talk to smart people! Let me have this!
: What the fuck is that supposed to mean?! I’m smart!
: Are you?
: Yes!
: Maybe not Nodoka or Makoto smart, but I’m not a fucking idiot! I’m definitely above average at least!
: Then...contribute and prove your worth or whatever it is Nodoka suggested.
: What the fuck does that even- ugh!
: Salutations, seasoned intellectuals. May I burden you with my presence in exchange for a tiny little tidbit of information relevant to my current state of being?
: Because I do believe it may help you all understand me a little better and all I really want is to get along.
Kirin leaves out the part about getting naked and fingering everyone, which is what I, a real intellectual, know she actually wants.
: What is this “tidbit” of relevant information, Kirin? Because if it’s something as simple as just feeling left out, that’s hardly new information and changes absolutely nothing.
: Mmmmm...that depends. But I yield my time to the girl from dorm ten.
: Do you know what FOMO stands for, Makoto?
: The fear of missing out, obviously. But that’s no excuse for-
: Actually, it is an excuse.
: And while it’s not technically a “new” psychological phenomenon, rapid advancements in technology have been making it significantly more common lately.
: It’s even seeing a substantial increase in presence in medical journals- a thing that, surprise, I read! Because I’m a big, smart girl just like you!
: Oh! And did you know that the links between FOMO and more medically accepted conditions like anxiety and depression are gathering more and more support every year?
: Would you tell someone that depression isn’t a good enough reason for their actions, Makoto?
: Or are you just caught up in the equally interesting psychological phenomenon of being a fucking bitch?
: Damn, Makoto! You just gonna let her FO your MO like that?!
: That...
: Depression isn’t...
: Ugh. Fine. You win. I’m sorry.
: You can stay and hang out with us. I didn’t mean to ostracize you. And now that I understand you’re psychologically compelled to-
: Thanks but no thanks. I’m gonna go walk around the halls and try to find someone a little less smart to talk to since I’m not good enough for you.
: Oh, come on. I didn’t mean it. I told you I’m sorry.
: Wanna come with me, Sensei? Or are you too good for me now too?
: You worded that question in a way that makes it very hard for me to refuse without sounding like a complete asshole.
: You’re already a complete asshole and have done much worse. But I suck too, so I guess we can just go suck together or something.
I hope that has a double meaning.
Actually, knowing Kirin, it probably has a double meaning.
And so I am left with no other choice but to do this.
: Sure.
: You should apologize to Makoto for calling her a bitch, though.
: No thanks.
: Well, you can’t say I didn’t try.
: That girl’s gonna cause some problems for us, isn’t she?
: No...She’s normally fine in school. I just pushed her a little too far.
: And, on that note, I need another glass of wine. But when I return...more genomics.
Kirin waits for me near the door and the two of us walk out together.
I can feel the irritation essentially pouring out of her, so I really do hope that wherever the two of us wind up going is somewhere that can kind of...absorb it, I guess.
Or maybe I can just fuck it out of her.
That sounds like a better idea.
: Okay! I managed to pry the microphone out of Ami’s hands and got a second one just for you.
: I hope you’re good at Spanish, cause-
: Did you see that just now?
: See what? What’s wrong?
: Sensei and...my sister. Walking out together. Where do you think they’re going?
: Sensei and Kirin? I don’t know. Maybe they’re just taking a walk or something?
: A walk...
: Do you...want to follow them or something? I can just give these back, you know. Despacito is forever, so we can sing whenever we want.
: No. I’m probably just being weird. I’m sure it’s nothing.
: Yeah. I’m definitely weird.
: Wait...Spanish?
: Sensei and...Kirin?...
: Yeah...
: They just...left.
: They walked right past me...
: Isn’t that kind of weird?...
: Ayane?
: Let’s just...
: Sing...
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!
